newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas says expanding Latam activities.
newsitem.headline: Danzas says expanding Latam activities.

text.p: Swiss-based freight forwarding concern Danzas AG said that it has opened subsidiaries in Peru, Ecuador and Brazil.
"With these regional openings, the Danzas Group is now present with its own organisation in all key Latin American markets," the company said in a statement.
"At the same time, Danzas can now expand its service in industrial project forwarding within Latin America," it said.

It said that it would concentrate mainly in air and ocean freight imports, including customs clearance, in Peru and Ecuador. In Brazil it would offer air and ocean freight services, as well as import and export services.
